description:
You are a systems analyst documenting a hospital patient management system. A Context Diagram has already been created in '~/Diagrams/hospital_dfd.drawio'. Your task is to decompose this into a Level-0 DFD and a Level-1 DFD based on the specification provided in '~/Desktop/patient_system_spec.txt'.

1. Open '~/Diagrams/hospital_dfd.drawio'.
2. Create a NEW PAGE named 'Level-0 DFD'. Draw the 5 main processes (1.0 to 5.0), data stores (D1-D5), and external entities as specified.
3. Create another NEW PAGE named 'Level-1 Billing'. Decompose Process 4.0 into sub-processes (4.1 to 4.4) and data stores as specified.
4. Ensure all data flows are labeled.
5. Export the final diagram as an SVG file to '~/Diagrams/exports/hospital_dfd.svg'.

Note: Use standard DFD notation (Circles/Ellipses for processes, Open Rectangles or Parallel Lines for data stores, Squares/Rectangles for entities).
